doc.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Which New Orleans bands recorded locally
summary: Barker and White list the few New Orleans bands that recorded, such as Sam Morgan, Celestin and Jones-Collins, while Piron recorded in New York.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did Lucien . . . Louis and Paul were very famous and well-known. Did Lucien ever record or did he stay in New Orleans?
No. None of them recorded. He didn’t record. Only one or two bands recorded here. That was Sam Morgan that came through, and somebody else. I think Sharkey [Bonano]. That’s all. Maybe Louis Dumaine.
Here [in New Orleans]. I’m talking about recording here.
. . . and [Oscar] Celestin did a couple of numbers.
Yes. And Jones-Collins in the late ’20s. Just a few.
But [Armand] Piron done his thing in New York. Studio.
New York, mostly. When did you first hear . . .
